mathematics.assertion_tested: On all 16 preregistered exact Gaussian-rational frames, all accepted grouped outcomes satisfy bosonic <= rejecting signed-wave <= always-feasible signed-wave; both classical laws are normalized with an explicit failure outcome; full Fock probabilities agree with independent permutation enumeration. Two local Perceval SLOS distributions must match within 1e-10. Exact two-qubit frontier and two relabelings are checked. The unstratified all-CF extension must fail normalization with mass 913/625.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact Q(i) represented by pairs of Fraction for primary assertions; float64 only for two Perceval cross-checks and a 2048-attempt classical sampler execution
mathematics.conventions: Rows are output modes; occupied input columns are the first k; one photon per distinct input. Groups are disjoint and exactly one detected photon per group is accepted. All other occupations and losses are failures. Per-output probability is |per|^2 divided by output occupation factorials; no postselection renormalization.
inputs: 16 cases frozen by research/P41_encoding_probe.py: k=1,2,3,4 with m<=8
Hand controls: product rails, Walsh Bell readout and two rational sharp-frontier frames
Rational rotation seeds 2026112401 through 2026112409; two fixed row relabelings
Variable groups, singleton herald with vacuum remainder, and row-attenuated contraction
Classical sampler seed 2026112411, 2048 attempts on the fixed Walsh control
non_claims: Finite checks are not a proof for arbitrary k
No graph-optimization training or held-out benchmark is performed
No independent proof review or novelty conclusion follows
Attempt dominance does not give a universal adaptive-training or realized-query-cost no-go
Arbitrary collision-free k-of-m decoding is outside the normalized grouping theorem
No QPU acquisition, hardware authorization or manuscript change

randomness.generator: Python random.Random for frozen rational gates, NumPy default_rng for the classical sampler
